A finite birational morphism from the smooth P(O(-3)⊕O(-1)) is built explicitly, and both singular-line affine normalizations are k[t^3,u,tu]⊂k[t,u], with exact conductor (u,tu)^2. The line classification handles independent/dependent U,V, exhausting all geometric lines. Frobenius is bijective on finite fields, giving counts and zeta for all extensions. Exact packaged verifier corroborates q=3,9,27 counts and q=3,9 complete line sets; finite experiments are not substituted for infinite proofs.

The exact normalization, square conductor, complete line set, and arithmetic zeta resolve structural bad-reduction and enumeration questions, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
